reconciliation.disposition: See token classification and source path. Parser-only boundary aliases/diagnostics are not claimed simulator emissions; static emitter-only tokens are package-wide and may be other-mod, specialized format, or diagnostic. Supported-format state records missing from parser were added only where source audit established common Gen 9 use.
